description: This file defines classes representing PDF content stream objects in the PDFsharp library, including base classes, comments, sequences, numbers, strings, names, arrays, and operators, with methods for cloning, serialization, and debugging.

classes.name: CObject
classes.description: Abstract base class for all PDF content stream objects, providing cloning and writing capabilities.

classes.name: CComment
classes.description: Represents a comment in a PDF content stream.

classes.name: CSequence
classes.description: Represents a sequence of PDF objects, supporting list operations and content serialization.

classes.name: CNumber
classes.description: Abstract base class for numerical PDF objects.

classes.name: CInteger
classes.description: Represents an integer value in a PDF content stream.

classes.name: CReal
classes.description: Represents a real (double) value in a PDF content stream.

classes.name: CString
classes.description: Represents a string in a PDF content stream, with support for different string types.

classes.name: CStringType
classes.description: Enumeration of string formats in PDF content streams.

classes.name: CName
classes.description: Represents a name object in a PDF content stream.

classes.name: CArray
classes.description: Represents an array of PDF objects.

classes.name: COperator
classes.description: Represents an operator in a PDF content stream, including operands and operator name.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the object.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes the object to a ContentWriter.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
